name: Gasthof Maierhof
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated with lovely views in Westendorf, Gasthof Maierhof features well-appointed rooms and delicious home-style regional fare. It caters perfectly to hikers, skiers, and families.

The Alpenrosenbahn cable car, access to SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental, and scenic trails are right at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Maierhof in Westendorf provides warm hospitality and alpine charm in the Kitzbuehel Alps.
